nodes_gateway_desc: The fleet's one door; a node joins at its first check-in
nodes_never_checked_in: No check-in since the gateway started
nodes_config_none_hint: No configuration copy yet; a node does not listen until it has its first one
nodes_menu_remove_hint: Only an unreachable node can be removed
nodes_swap_dialog_desc: How many GiB of swap the node's daemon manages on its own data disk, on top of the host's own. Growing mounts at the next check-in; shrinking waits for that host's next reboot, a running swap block is never unmounted.
nodes_swap_saved: Swap target for {id} set to {gb} GiB, applied at its next check-in
nodes_remove_desc: This says it is gone for good: its record is deleted, its sandboxes are no longer looked for, and a name that lived only there becomes a new name again. A node removed by mistake comes back at its next check-in.
nodes_remove_absent: “{id}” was not there to begin with
nodes_empty_title: No node has checked in yet
nodes_empty_description: A node joins the fleet at its first check-in. Install the daemon, point DORMICE_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT at this gateway, and it appears here within 15 seconds.
nodes_detail_not_found_desc: It may have been removed, or it has not checked in yet.
nodes_host_desc: Resource levels and trends of this machine
nodes_host_swap_unreadable: Swap is not readable on this platform
nodes_host_swap_warning: Freezing needs swap — see dor doctor
nodes_host_disk_missing: This host has no data directory
